text:
Anya: quick heads up — saw a regression on token breakdown after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak. p95 token_compute for /chat large-seq jumped from ~6ms -> ~12ms.

Mike: which selector change? the gpu_favor branch? :grimacing:

Anya: yes. selector now prefers xformers attention for seq>1024. Perf lab numbers were okay but prod traces show queue_wait increased and compute per token also higher for many requests.

Sanjay: can you drop a sample trace and a slow-request list? want to see batch sizes and KV hit profile.

Anya: links:
- trace: http://tracing.internal/trace/abcd-req-0001
- slow-requests panel: /d/redwood/runtime-slow-requests?var-route=/chat

Tara: reminder — current metrics are route-aggregates only. we don't surface a stable request_id -> trace link in Grafana, which makes root-cause slower.

perf-bot: alert: /chat p95 token_latency rose 2x at 2026-03-16T14:02Z (anomaly detected)

Mike: initial hypothesis: selector picks xformers kernel. For many requests batch-sizes are small due to prefix eviction so xformers loses batching efficiency, plus KV misses add precompute overhead.

Eva: we should correlate per-request: kernel_used, batch_size, kv_hit_rate, trace_id. but cannot add trace_id as metric label (cardinality).

Sanjay: agree. plan: emit compact per-request JSON logs (indexed) + keep metrics aggregated. sampling for spans.

Anya: proposed minimal implementation:
1) runtime emits 1-line JSON log per request with request_id, trace_id, route, kernel_choice, batch_size, kv_hits, kv_misses, avg_token_compute_ms
   example line:
   ```
   INFO runtime_req request_id=rt-9012 trace_id=abcd-req-0001 route=/chat kernel=xformers batch_size=6 kv_hits=42 kv_misses=14 avg_token_compute_ms=10.9
   ```
2) metrics: maintain per-route histograms token_compute_ms and token_queue_ms (no trace_id label)
3) tracing: add per-token spans with attributes kernel and kv_hit (1% deterministic sampling; errors always sampled)
4) dashboard: per-request breakdown widget that links request_id -> logs + trace

Mike: runtime change is small. will include a compact tokens_summary field like tokens=140 kv_hit_pct=76 batch_hist=\"1:3,2:9,3:1\" to keep cardinality low.

Anya: sample JSON log as single line (for indexing):
```json
{"request_id":"rt-9012","trace_id":"abcd-req-0001","route":"/chat","kernel":"xformers","batch_size":"6","tokens":"140","kv_hit_pct":"76","batch_histogram":"1:3,2:9,3:1","avg_token_compute_ms":"10.9"}
```

Sanjay: we'll index these logs in fast-search (7d retention) and surface them from Grafana. dashboard flow idea:
- per-route KPIs p50/p95/p99 token_compute_ms + token_queue_ms
- table of recent slow requests: request_id, route, kernel, avg_token_compute_ms, kv_hit_pct
- clicking request_id opens modal with trace link, JSON log, and inline token-latency timeseries for that request

Eva: sampling: deterministic by hash(request_id) % 100 < sample_rate (1). force-sample on any error or SLO breach.

Mike: add kernel_selector_version label in logs so we can compare before/after behavior.

Tara: ops notes:
- batch_histogram must be compact (string) to avoid explosion
- scrub any user text from logs (no input payload)
- measure logging overhead (~0.5ms/request reported)

Anya: timeline proposal:
- Mike: PR to add request JSON log + selector_version tag (today)
- Tracing team (Sanjay/tracing-bot): implement deterministic sampling + token span attrs (tomorrow)
- Dashboard Team: prototype per-request modal + slow-requests table (EOD Wed)
- Ops: new alert when /chat p95 token_compute_ms > 10ms

tracing-bot: added deterministic sampling hook: runtime.config.sampling.method=hash(request_id). errors forced-sampled.

Mike: also returning headers for client linking: X-RD-TRACE: abcd-req-0001 and X-RD-REQ: rt-9012. small overhead but helps external debugging.

Anya: once we gather several fully-sampled traces we can see whether kernel selection or KV miss behavior dominates.

Eva: after data lands we'll run an A/B by kernel_selector_version across seq_len buckets and kv_hit ranges, share stat test here.

perf-bot: add CI perf test for seq_len=1500 kv-miss heavy scenario.

Mike: PR incoming. I'll ping when merged and post some sampled trace IDs here.

Anya: thanks all. please paste any sampled trace IDs back into this thread so Dashboard can validate links.
